incidence: the LMT office offers an immutable Leader message and language-map request across the enterprise seam
the ANT admits the request and its semiote performs the bounded parse under colony law
the semiote returns a candidate parse or refusal to the LMT office without writing LMT state

precondition.description: The customer supplies one source string, an exact source activity, and one language map admitted by the ANT Colony.

move.description: The ANT admits the service act and its semiote derives a source-bound parse forest and discourse state.

postcondition.description: The LMT receives a candidate reading or refusal, the source and ambiguities remain inspectable, and only the LMT may admit the result locally.
